Priya: Quick question: are we leaning fast-fail (return error asap when upstream overloaded) or smooth-degrade (serve partial stream / early trailers) for gateway overload handling?
Alex: my vote: smooth-degrade for user-facing apps, fast-fail for internal batch RPCs. get SLOs aligned.
Daniel: Agree. Observability is tough for smooth-degrade though — how do we measure "partial success" vs real failure?
Maria: Proposal: export three metrics: gateway_streaming_partial_responses, gateway_early_abort_errors, gateway_complete_success. Also add a tag "degrade_mode".
Sam: Also we need an ergonomic client-visible signal, otherwise apps can't adapt. Suggest header `X-RW-Degrade: partial` and trailer `x-rw-stream-status: partial|complete|failed`.
Priya: Love the header idea. How do we make retries safe with partial streams? double-delivery risk.
Alex: For retries we must separate idempotent vs non-idempotent. For streaming idempotency we can introduce a resume token: `X-RW-Resume-Token: <opaque>` and a `resume_offset` in tokens.
Sam: Sketch: on first connect, gateway returns `X-RW-Resume-Token` in trailer. Client can attempt resume within N seconds using `X-RW-Resume-Token` and `X-RW-Client-Retry: 1`.
Daniel: Need to account for billing and metrics: resumed continuations shouldn't double-bill tokens already delivered. Mark resumed requests with `retry.kind=resume` metric label.
Maria: Observability: add trace events when we switch to degrade mode: `edge.degrade.switch` with reason (cpu|queue|upstream-error). Also log the resume-token issuance.
Priya: Ops question: does smooth-degrade require more memory (buffering) at gateway? My worry is it can worsen OOM.
Alex: It can, if we buffer. Alternative is passthrough with early trailer indicating partial; no huge buffer. We should prefer streaming passthrough.
Sam: Implementation note: minimal change to proxy: add trailer writer and token issuance. Pseudocode:
`````
if (upstream.overloaded) {
  write_trailer("x-rw-stream-status", "partial");
  issue_resume_token();
}
`````
infra-bot: deploy 2023-11-07T18:21:03Z: integrated branch `edge/degrade-trace` to staging :rocket:
Daniel: One more: client-backpressure interplay. If client is slow and gateway queues, we should not treat that as upstream overload.
Priya: Agreed. Need separate signals: queue_latency vs upstream_backpressure. We can expose both as metrics.
Maria: Action items: (1) Alex & Sam to spec headers/trailers and resume-token format. (2) Daniel to add metrics + labels. (3) Priya to draft SLO guidance doc.
Alex: I'll drop a short RFC snippet by EOD. @Sam you good to prototype token issuance?
Sam: Yup, will hack a PoC tomorrow.
Priya: Thanks all :heart:
